== Summary ==
Slip “•Tatooine: Dune Sea” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF file created 2 February 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (853, 1535, 1540, 2083)). Version [[Tatooine: Dune Sea (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
